subject: website
name: EIP-7951 DNSSEC Solutions
summary: A demo site for EIP-7951 P-256 DNSSEC verification with ENS. The linked steg-eth repository holds the contracts and demos but no front end matching this build, and the site is a minified bundle, so it stays Level 2. Its bundled wallet libraries also send telemetry to MetaMask and Coinbase when the page opens.
